title: SIDESTORY: ACT OR DIE OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: ACT OR DIE OPEN
DURATION: November 13, 2025, 08:00 – December 4, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Act or Die event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from the Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
Phase 1 [Performance Begins]
DURATION: November 13, 2025, 08:00 – November 27, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Phase 2 [For Drama, For Eternity]
DURATION: November 20, 2025, 16:00 – November 27, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Backlot Entertainment Projects]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Backlot Entertainment Projects] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Miss.Christine], Wrankwood Studio Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, [Phantom of the Studio], etc.
[Studio Self-Service Bar]
DURATION: November 13, 2025, 08:00 – December 4, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Phantom of the Studio by clearing event stages and completing [Backlot Entertainment Projects] missions. Phantom of the Studio can be used to redeem items from [Studio Self-Service Bar]. REWARDS: Miss.Christine's token, Wrankwood Studio Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, 0011 Tempest Series - 'Afternoon Teatime' for Aciddrop, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – DITHYRAMB UNENDING
DURATION: November 13, 2025, 08:00 – November 27, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Dithyramb Unending], opens, and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Tragodia
★★★★★: Tippi / Rockrock
NOTE:

This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Tragodia
★★★★★: Tippi / Miss.Christine
NOTE:
Operator Miss.Christine is currently ONLY available from the Act or Die event, and is NOT available in [Dithyramb Unending] headhunting or any [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting].
Tragodia and Tippi will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after November 27, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
Tragodia, Tippi, and Miss.Christine will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 EPOQUE COLLECTION & ITERATION PROVIDENT SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: November 13, 2025, 08:00 – December 4, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Iteration Provident Series - Phototaxis for Ascalon
EPOQUE Collection - Stranded for Highmore
EPOQUE Collection - Tidal Bore for Lucilla
05 RE-EDITION OUTFITS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: November 13, 2025, 08:00 – November 27, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
0011 Tempest Series - Hear the Wind Sing for Fartooth
0011 Tempest Series - The Fruition for Shalem
0011 Tempest Series - The Road to Here for Paprika
Test Collection Series - There They Be for Saga
Rhodes Kitchen Collection - Sweet Jackpot for Insider
Vitafield Series - Freeland Tuneseeker for Czerny
06 NEW FURNITURE SET – WRANKWOOD STUDIO
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, Wrankwood Studio will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Act or Die event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: November 13, 2025, 08:00 – November 27, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
07 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DURATION: November 13, 2025, 08:00 – November 27, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
Supporter Chip Pack
CONTENTS: Supporter Dualchip * 4, Supporter Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Wrankwood Movie Funds Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 13, LMD * 300000
08 NEW REDEEMABLES AVAILABLE IN [DISTINCTIONS] AND [UNIVERSAL CERTIFICATES EXCHANGE AREA]
UPDATE TIME: November 13, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: New redeemables in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area]:
MARTHE Sports Line - Rest Between Sets for Broca
Test Collection Series - Fresh Fastener for Amiya
Please stay tuned for more information!
